baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative اغدوا, the destination حرثكم, and the predicate صارمين form one timed work instruction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Early setting-out opens a narrow work window; cultivation supplies the worked asset; crop-cutting supplies the intended operation; and كنتم predicates readiness as the condition for executing it.

activation_trace.role: Early-day setting-out supplies the operation's time gate and coordinated departure.
Sowing and cultivation supply the worked crop that is now ready for an operation.
Being or occurring in time makes cutter-readiness a presently predicated state.
Cutting the palm crop specifies the ordinary agricultural task assigned to the group.

changed_reading.before: Go to your field and harvest it.
changed_reading.after: Set out together at first light for the crop, provided that you already occupy the state of a crew ready to cut it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حرثكم can name accumulated earning and work, while صارمين can name both separation and decisive resolve.
baseline_models.mechanism: The possessive asset is heard as gathered earnings rather than land alone. The predicate then describes agents resolved to make a clean separation in those earnings, while كنتم gives that role the force of an undertaking.

activation_trace.role: Gathering, earning, and labor turn the cultivation into accumulated productive gain.
Undertaking responsibility makes the conditional predicate sound like a role the speakers bind themselves to perform.
Severing and discontinuity supply a separation broader than the physical cutting of fruit.
Decisive resolve supplies the agents' hard intention to complete that separation.

changed_reading.before: The line identifies people technically able to harvest.
changed_reading.after: The line summons people who treat accumulated gain as theirs to separate decisively and completely.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: اغدوا places صارمين exactly at the transition into morning.
baseline_models.mechanism: Morning is not inert scenery: the root image of night and day cutting one another makes dawn the first severance in the sentence. The human cutters are invited to imitate a temporal cut already occurring around them.

activation_trace.role: First light and departure locate the human action at the day's opening boundary.
Temporal occurrence lets the conditional state coincide with the dawn transition.
Night and day cutting each other off make the morning boundary a material analogue for the intended cut.

changed_reading.before: Morning merely tells the workers when to leave.
changed_reading.after: Dawn performs a cut before they do: the proposed harvest is synchronized with night being severed from day.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إن كنتم صارمين predicates an agent identity rather than stating only a future action.
baseline_models.mechanism: The conditional asks whether decisive cutting is truly their present state. This makes صارمين a claim about who they are while acting, not merely a job label.

activation_trace.role: Present-state predication turns the conditional into a test of occupied identity.
Decisive resolve defines the identity whose truth the condition tests.

changed_reading.before: If you intend to harvest, leave now.
changed_reading.after: If decisive cutters are what you truly are, enact that claimed identity now.

context_deltas.mechanism: The broad severance baseline becomes specifically social. Withholding the hand, barring entry to subsistence, and proceeding in a contracted state define the intended cut as exclusion of the needy; the later declaration of deprivation reverses that cut onto the owners.

activation_trace.role: Withholding the hand from giving supplies the social form that crop-severance will take.
Accumulated earning supplies the contested good from which another party can be excluded.
Severing supplies the reversible relation between owners, produce, and excluded recipient.
Literal entry supplies the boundary the owners intend to close.
Sustenance that stabilizes a person's dwelling makes the excluded person's material claim concrete.
Prevention and contraction turn their energetic departure into a withholding posture.
Deprivation and failure to obtain the goal return exclusion to the would-be excluders.

structural_cues: The command's على حرثكم is followed by على حرد, replacing the productive destination with a withholding disposition.
The whispered clause in 68:24 names the excluded miskin, and 68:27 immediately makes the owners the deprived party.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withholding, blocked entry, subsistence, contraction, and subsequent deprivation; I supply the directional claim that the owners' intended social cut rebounds onto them. A live alternative is a simple punishment sequence without lexical reciprocity.

changed_reading.before: Be decisive in separating the crop from its plants.
changed_reading.after: Carry out the plan to sever the crop from a needy claimant, a severance that will return as your own separation from the crop.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated morning markers, lowered speech, a bounded 'today,' renewed early departure, and prevention convert dawn from efficient work time into a gatekeeping technology. Timing determines who can know, arrive, and share.

activation_trace.role: Early departure supplies the focus action whose social purpose is reclassified by the sequence.
First morning light supplies the repeated narrow window in which the group coordinates.
Lowered, secret speech makes the early schedule a concealment mechanism.
A bounded daytime interval supplies the deadline for preventing another person's arrival.
The enacted early setting-out confirms that the focus imperative became an operational schedule.
Prevention and withdrawal name the access-control purpose carried by that schedule.

structural_cues: Morning language recurs in 68:17, 68:20, and 68:21 before the focus imperative is enacted again in 68:25.
The sequence moves from public calling to low speech and then to an explicit ban on entry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated dawn timing, whispered coordination, a same-day deadline, and prevention; I infer that timing is chosen to control access rather than merely to avoid heat. Ordinary agricultural efficiency remains a materially live alternative.

changed_reading.before: Leave early because harvesting is morning work.
changed_reading.after: Leave before others can arrive: dawn is being used to monopolize knowledge, entry, and distribution.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root moves from their vowed cutting, through the focus agent-predicate, to the garden's already cut-off or calamitous appearance. Morning becoming completes a role reversal: those who planned to be the cutters meet a crop whose state has preempted their agency.

activation_trace.role: The vowed cutting of the crop supplies the group's intended transitive act.
The agent predicate turns cutting and separation into the identity they claim en route.
A calamitous cut-off condition transfers the root image from intended agents to the devastated garden.
Becoming supplies the state-change by which the garden reaches that condition before them.

structural_cues: The sequence repeats ص ر م as vowed verb in 68:17, agent predicate in 68:22, and result-comparison in 68:20's prior-night event as reconstructed at dawn.
The owners' action remains future in their speech while the garden's counter-state is already complete.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one root across intended act, claimed identity, and resultant garden-state; I supply the arrow of agency reversal, where the object reaches the cut state before the cutters act. A live alternative takes كالصريم only as a visual comparison with no role exchange.

changed_reading.before: Become the people who cut the crop.
changed_reading.after: Claim the cutter-role while unknowingly approaching a crop whose prior cut-off state has already made that role empty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The conditional identity 'if you are decisive cutters' is retrospectively overwritten by two confessional identities built with the same being-root: 'we were withholders of right' and 'we were transgressors.' The context does not deny their resolve; it renames what that resolve made them.

activation_trace.role: State predication makes صارمين the first self-defining label in the sequence.
Decisive resolve supplies the apparently competent identity later subjected to renaming.
Repeated being-in-a-state carries the same identity grammar into their confession.
Withholding or imprisoning a right specifies what was morally inside their cutter identity.
A second repeated state-predicate confirms that the group is revising its own self-description.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies the final name for their decisive excess.

structural_cues: إن كنتم صارمين is answered by إنا كنا ظالمين and إنا كنا طاغين, preserving the copular identity frame while changing its predicate.
The plural speakers remain the same coordinated group across command, action, and confession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated ك و ن predications and the later confessed labels; I infer that the latter are retrospective corrections of the focus label. The repetition could alternatively be ordinary copular grammar without deliberate identity revision.

changed_reading.before: Cutter is the group's competent working identity.
changed_reading.after: Cutter is their provisional self-name; once the plan is exposed, they rename the same state as withholding right and crossing a limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the parable, one context root holds cutting/harvest residue, acquisition, and offense in neighboring branches. That convergence compresses the focus's حرث plus صرم mechanism: this harvest is also something the agents earn as culpability.

activation_trace.role: Earning and gathering supply the acquisition side of the focus operation.
Crop-cutting supplies the agricultural act that the later root inventory morally recombines.
Cutting and harvest supply a direct material echo of صارمين inside the word used for offenders.
Gain and earning join the productive asset to what the agents acquire through their act.
Offense and guilt convert the acquired harvest into acquired culpability.

structural_cues: The criminals question in 68:35 follows the garden account before the surah turns to guarantees and judgment.
The focus already places earning/cultivation and crop-cutting in one short construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a single ج ر م inventory branching to harvest-cut, gain, and offense at a post-parable reference to criminals; I infer retroactive compression of those senses onto the focus action. The live alternative activates only the conventional offender sense in 68:35.

changed_reading.before: They seek a crop through a morally bad plan.
changed_reading.after: Their cutting is itself an earning event in two registers: they seek produce and acquire the culpability encoded by that harvest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The owners' direct imperative projects a complete tomorrow as if speech could inscribe it. The surah's writing frame, including a cut-line image, and its later challenge about writing the unseen make the command an unauthorized future-script that reality revises.

activation_trace.role: The pared writing-stick supplies the surah-level instrument for fixing a projected outcome.
A line of striking and cutting materially couples inscription to the crop-cutting plan.
The next-day image supplies the not-yet-seen future that the speakers treat as settled.
Decisive resolve gives their spoken projection the force of a self-authored decree.
Writing that fixes a binding judgment supplies the authority their imperative implicitly assumes.
What is hidden from sight supplies the future knowledge they lack while scripting the harvest.

structural_cues: Ayah 68:22 is the owners' own imperative after they call one another, not an external narration of a completed act.
The later question pairs possession of the unseen with writing, precisely the two capacities their confident schedule presumes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, a cut-line, next-day futurity, binding inscription, and the unseen; I infer that the command performs a miniature attempt to author tomorrow. A live alternative confines the writing questions to the surah's deniers and does not feed them back into the garden speech.

changed_reading.before: The owners issue a practical instruction about tomorrow.
changed_reading.after: The owners speak tomorrow as though already written, using decisive cutting language to author an unseen outcome they do not possess.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus command sits inside an oath with no excluded remainder. Branches of allotment, exception, binding record, oath, and guarantee make their resolve resemble a private contract assigning the whole yield to themselves. Later questions expose the absence of any book, enduring oath, or guarantor for that title.

activation_trace.role: Oath-taking supplies an earlier profile of speech used to force certainty.
Separating and allotting shares turns the harvest oath into a distribution decision.
An oath divided among its parties supplies the group's collective bond to that allotment.
Taking an item out of the whole supplies the exception they refuse to make.
Gathered earnings supply the asset over which the group asserts exclusive title.
Undertaking responsibility lets the conditional sound like self-guarantee of performance.
A written act that establishes judgment supplies the missing instrument of legitimate entitlement.
A binding oath supplies the later test of whether their promised outcome has real duration.
Bearing a guarantee supplies the absent party who could underwrite their claim.

structural_cues: The owners swear in 68:17, omit exception in 68:18, and speak the focus command as a coordinated performance of that bond.
Ayat 68:37-40 ask in sequence about a book, enduring oaths, and which claimant will guarantee the asserted outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oath, allotment, omitted exception, binding record, enduring oath, and guarantor; I infer that the owners mistake collective resolve for valid title to the whole yield. The later legal questions may instead address a broader audience without specifically reopening the garden oath.

changed_reading.before: If you are determined, carry out the harvest.
changed_reading.after: Act as though your oath, solidarity, and resolve were sufficient deed and guarantee for exclusive possession of the entire yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus praises its own decisiveness, and the walkers immediately imagine measured capability. Later images of extension, hidden strategy, and durable firmness place that local plan inside a slower and stronger counterplan. Their resolve is real but not sovereign.

activation_trace.role: Decisive resolve supplies the group's confidence that intention can close the event.
Planning by measure and calculation makes their confidence an apparently controlled design.
Extended time and respite supply the delayed scale on which the counterplan works.
A concealed strategic treatment supplies the plan that encloses their visible plan.
Extended solidity supplies a firmness greater than their momentary decisiveness.

structural_cues: The focus conditional إن كنتم صارمين is enacted by the claim that they go قادرين in 68:25.
The later first-person statement pairs deliberate respite with a strategy explicitly called firm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies their decisive, measured posture and a later delayed, firm strategy; I infer plan-within-counterplan and read the focus confidence ironically. The live alternative treats 68:45 as a general warning with no special backward scope over the garden plan.

changed_reading.before: Their resolve is the sufficient cause of the intended harvest.
changed_reading.after: Their measured resolve is only a local layer of agency, already enclosed by a delayed and firmer counter-strategy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cultivation productively covers seed, and a garden is physically covered by trees; the owners turn that useful covering into concealed speech and concealed blessing. The focus's crop-work therefore sits at a fork where covering can nurture growth or hide a good from others.

activation_trace.role: A garden covered by trees supplies the productive enclosure in which the focus cultivation stands.
Sowing seed supplies the agricultural process that requires material covering for growth.
Covering seed supplies the productive pole of concealment within cultivation.
Concealing a blessing supplies the destructive social pole enacted by the owners' secrecy.

structural_cues: The site is introduced as a garden, while 68:23 makes the owners' speech covert and 68:24 reveals what that cover protects.
The final disbelief context supplies one root inventory containing both seed-covering and blessing-concealment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tree-cover, sowing, seed-covering, and blessing-concealment; I infer a valence reversal from nurturing concealment to monopolizing concealment. A live alternative treats the final ك ف ر branches as too distant to reactivate the focus cultivation.

changed_reading.before: حرثكم is simply the crop they have cultivated.
changed_reading.after: Their cultivation exposes two kinds of covering: one shelters seed so life emerges, while their plan shelters possession so benefit cannot circulate.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus form of غ د و plainly denotes early departure, while the cited sale image is branch-distant and appears again only late in the surah. It remains valid because the focus joins that root to a cultivated asset and the packet independently supplies sale of a crop before ripeness; downstream prose should render it as an undertone of premature commodification, not as a claim that اغدوا literally commands a sale.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The branch cluster attaches to focus اغدوا and حرثكم as a not-yet-secured productive asset treated as already available.

activation_trace.role: An unborn young or uncertain sale-object supplies a claim on value before its realization.
Cultivation supplies the growing asset whose yield is not secured until maturation and harvest.
Sale of standing crop before its fitness supplies an independent packet image of premature realization.

changed_reading.before: They go to collect a crop that is simply theirs.
changed_reading.after: Their command treats anticipated growth as an already owned and realizable commodity before the yield is actually secured.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the surrounding garden narrative strongly selects orchard agriculture. It remains focus-anchored because three separate focus roots align in one animal-production chain: unborn stock, an animal worn by use, and milk cut off. Downstream prose should preserve this only as a submerged husbandry register within productive ownership, never as replacement of the garden scene.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: All three images resolve from words in 68:22 and form a coherent alternate production cycle beneath the dominant crop reading.

activation_trace.role: Unborn young supply latent productive value not yet brought into possession.
An animal weakened through use supplies exploitation of a productive body.
Milk being cut off supplies the terminal loss of that body's yield.

changed_reading.before: The focus contains only a crop-production vocabulary.
changed_reading.after: Beneath the orchard sense, the line also resonates with extracting animal productivity from gestation through use to a cut-off yield.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the early-meal and one-meal branches are not the normal senses of the focus forms. It remains valid through the line's productive earnings, the explicitly bounded day, and the named poor person's subsistence; downstream prose should qualify it as a food-allocation resonance rather than translate صارمين as ration-cutters.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus اغدوا, حرثكم, and صارمين can align as early food, earned provision, and a meal that closes the day.

activation_trace.role: The early-day meal turns morning from work time into a moment of provisioning.
Earning through work supplies the provision available for allocation.
One meal that cuts off the day supplies the image of a finite daily ration.
The delimited day supplies the temporal unit within which access to food is denied.
Sustenance that maintains residence supplies the excluded person's concrete daily need.

changed_reading.before: The owners schedule the physical removal of fruit.
changed_reading.after: The schedule also carries a rationing image: they decide at daybreak whose labor-derived food will, and will not, sustain the day.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because no literal battle occurs in the garden episode. It remains anchored through the focus branch that stirs war, the predicate of hard resolve, and later anger, capability, and warfare branches; downstream prose should describe militarization of the group's posture, not turn the harvest into an actual military campaign.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: حرثكم and صارمين allow the work-party's movement to acquire the affect and organization of a raid on a productive asset.

activation_trace.role: Stirring fire and rousing war converts cultivation language into mobilization around a contested asset.
Hard resolve supplies the disciplined posture of the mobilized group.
Anger and rage supply the affective charge carried into the expedition.
Capability reaching action and possession supplies their sense of operational superiority.
War and combat provide a distant confirming image for the plan's militarized organization.

changed_reading.before: A work crew leaves to harvest efficiently.
changed_reading.after: The crew mobilizes with the resolve, anger, and possession-drive of a raid, even though its battlefield is its own productive holding.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because حرثكم is ordinarily the destination or crop, not a path, and the slipping cue occurs much later. It remains anchored in the focus preposition على plus a branch of trampled ground and in the immediate claim of being lost; downstream prose should render it as a spatial irony about presumed footing, not as the primary syntax of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: على حرثكم permits the cultivated holding to be imagined as ground beneath a confident advance.

activation_trace.role: Setting out supplies bodily movement toward apparently familiar ground.
Trampled ground and a hoof-worn track supply the presumed footing of their advance.
Loss of the intended path supplies their first explanation when familiar ground no longer answers expectation.
A smooth place on which the foot cannot hold supplies the surah's later image of failed footing.

changed_reading.before: They confidently go to a known property.
changed_reading.after: They advance as though ownership were stable ground, only to find that the familiar track no longer supports recognition or control.

strongest_changes: Morning changes from neutral work time into a gate that controls knowledge, arrival, and access.
The intended crop-cut rebounds: the needy person is to be severed from provision, then the owners are severed from the crop.
The claimed identity كنتم صارمين is retrospectively rewritten by كنا ظالمين and كنا طاغين.
The ج ر م inventory fuses harvest-cutting, acquisition, and guilt, making the harvest an act through which culpability is earned.
The oath, writing, and unseen frames expose the command as an unsupported title to and inscription of a future yield.
summary.what_was_special: The focus activated unusually tight cross-root mechanisms rather than isolated glosses: ص ر م reverses agent and result; ج ر م recombines cutting, gain, and crime; writing language shares a cut-line with harvest; and cultivation's productive covering can reverse into concealment of blessing. These readings coexist with the strong ordinary harvest reading instead of replacing it.
remaining_uncertainties: At 68:20, it is uncertain how strongly the calamity and night/day branches of صريم should supplement the ordinary image of a cut or blackened field.
The writing, guarantee, and counterplan frames may address the surah's wider deniers without intentionally feeding back into the garden owners' speech.
The seed-covering, premature-sale, husbandry, meal, martial, and unstable-footing readings are branch-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The exact social status of the miskin's claim is supplied by exclusion and subsistence imagery, while the direction from need to enforceable share remains reader inference.
